issues.title: Bug report - TS0046 / _TZ3000_iszegwpd 6 Gang Wall Remote fails to pair although Zigbee interview succeeds
issues.bodySnippet:
### Describe the bug

I am unable to pair a 6-button Zigbee remote SS9600ZB-V2 / T066 with Homey Pro using the Universal Tuya Zigbee / Tuya Unified app.

The device has the following Zigbee fingerprint:

> Model ID: TS0046
> Manufacturer: _TZ3000_iszegwpd
> Type: EndDevice

When I select 6 Gang Wall Remote in the app and put the remote into pairing mode, Homey displays that the device is being added, but the process ends with:

“Connection impossible”

However, the device actually joins the Homey Zigbee network and appears in Homey Developer Tools → Zigbee.

A manual Zigbee Interview completes successfully. The device reports:

> modelId: TS0046
> manufacturerName: _TZ3000_iszegwpd
> appVersion: 68
> hwVersion: 1
> batteryVoltage: 30
> batteryPercentageRemaining: 200

The Interview detects endpoints 1–4 successfully.

I also tested the device with the older Tuya Zigbee Homey app and experienced the same pairing failure.



### To Reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Open Homey and select Add Device.
2. Select Universal Tuya Zigbee / Tuya Unified.
3. Select 6 Gang Wall Remote.
4. Remove the battery from the SS9600ZB-V2 for about 20 seconds and reinstall it.
5. Put the remote into pairing mode by holding a button until the LED starts blinking.
6. Homey displays that the device is being added.
7. Keep pressing buttons periodically during pairing to keep the battery-powered Zigbee EndDevice awake.
8. Pairing eventually fails with “Connection impossible”.
9. Open Homey Developer Tools → Zigbee.
10. The device is visible there as: TS0046 / _TZ3000_iszegwpd
11. Run a manual Interview.
12. The Interview completes successfully, despite the pairing process having failed.
13. I also repeated the Interview while alternating buttons 5 and 6. The result was the same.



### Expected behavior

The device should be successfully created in Homey as 6 Gang Wall Remote, because it joins the Homey Zigbee network successfully, its Zigbee Interview completes successfully, and its fingerprint is:

> TS0046 / _TZ3000_iszegwpd

### App and Homey version

Homey model: Homey Pro (Early 2023), v. 13.5.1
Universal Tuya v.9.0.1295 Test

### Additional context

Device information:
> Product name: T066
> Model printed on box: SS9600ZB-V2
> Model ID: TS0046
> Manufacturer: _TZ3000_iszegwpd
> Device type: EndDevice
> appVersion: 68
> hwVersion: 1

The important point is that this does not appear to be a Zigbee join problem: the device is successfully present in the Homey Zigbee network and can be interviewed successfully. The failure seems to occur later in the pairing / device creation process.
